name: SubForce
author: Devko
summary: Analog-style monosynth in the spirit of a 37-key American paraphonic classic: two morphing oscillators with hard sync, a sub and white-to-pink noise, a mixer with its own feedback loop, a 4-pole transistor ladder (6 to 24 dB) with Multidrive, two looping DAHDSR envelopes, two mod busses, glide and Duo, 57 presets (many for melodic techno) and a six-tab touchscreen skin with Q-Links.
